outcome: Percentage of thinning of the scar region
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean section at Sifa University Hospital between May - October 2012
finding: The unlocked uterine closure technique was associated with less damage to the myometrium, as evidenced by significantly less scar thickness, niche, and percentage of thinning of the scar region.
mod_finding: This study focuses on different uterine closure techniques during cesarean section and does not directly compare cesarean section to vaginal birth.
